evidence.description: Descriptor blob at VA 0x00475140 decodes to "W55FA93 USB Card Reader 1.00"
Literal pool at 0x00030ab8 holds MMIO base 0xB8007000
Init stub at 0x00030a94 writes 0x32 to DAT_00030ab4+4 and sets bit1 in *(0xB8007000+0x7C)
APP.bin size 2,576,940 bytes; no trailing 0xFF padding

USB UDC Init function - writes 0x32 to DAT_00030ab4+4, sets bit1 at UDC_BASE+0x7C (0xB8007000+0x7C |= 0x2). Likely enables USB device controller. Called from 7+ functions: FUN_00012520, FUN_0002b930, FUN_00000264, FUN_0005dc78, FUN_0006406c, FUN_00068808, FUN_0006c4e0

UDC base 0xb8007000 identified via literal pools at 0x30ab8/0x323cc/0x46c28/0x46ebc/0x5c3d8/0x8b03c/0xb4068. Register access map: (1) FUN_00032310 writes base+0=0x1b1, base+4=0x4444, sets control bits at base+8 (|=0x80800 then |=0x10100), programs base+0x18=99, +0x1c=0x31, +0x24=0x3e7, +0x28=1, clears bits1-2 at base+0x40, and sets bit2 at base+0x7c – looks like SIE/PHY init and global interrupt enable. (2) FUN_0005c1a0 (top-level USB init) zeroes base+0x30/+0x34, clears bit3 at base+0x40, clears bit1 at base+0x7c, programs analog/PHY regs at base-0x5000..-0x4fe4 (0xb8002000/2004/200c/2018/201c) with 0/1/0x2ee0 and mask 0x68000000, then configures endpoint/FIFO region at base+0x1108/0x110c/0x1120/0x1124 (values 7→1, 3, 0xa0→0x7f, 0x30000066) before re-enabling clocks. (3) FUN_00046bfc and FUN_000b3f3c clamp a parameter 1..1000 then write base+0x28 (likely SOF interval/timeout). (4) FUN_00046e48 uses base+0x30=24000 and base+8 |=0x0100_0000, polling base+0x38 until 0 then clearing +0x30 (looped param times); FUN_0008adcc performs same sequence with base+0x30=0xf0. (5) FUN_00030a94 ORs base+0x7c with 0x2 (per-FIQ/interrupt enable). These touchpoints outline UDC init, timing, and interrupt paths where CDC hooks would attach.

Main USB bringup routine FUN_0002b930: Called only by FUN_000644d4 (high in boot). Performs full USB controller config with descriptor setup, endpoint configuration, and crypto/token generation. Calls USB init (FUN_00030a94) 5 times - one retry loop with 500ms delay until ready, four conditional resets based on state flag [r6+0xc8]. Programs MMIO bases 0x60000000 and 0x48000000 via helpers (in addition to known 0xB8007000). Key callees: FUN_00065954 (endpoint config, 4x), FUN_00065d64 (callback registration), FUN_000323dc (setup stages, 3x).

FUN_0005c1a0 detailed endpoint/FIFO register sequence: UDC base loaded from DAT_0005c3d8. Writes base+0x1108 (7→1, likely endpoint selector), base+0x110c (3), base+0x1120 (0xa0→0x7f, FIFO size/offset), base+0x1124 (0x30000066, config flags). Also clears base+0x30, base+0x34, base+0x40 bit3, base+0x7c bit1. Helper functions: FUN_000a1928 (early init), FUN_00031f34 (5 calls), FUN_0003224c (3 calls), FUN_00032310 (SIE/PHY), FUN_00080b7c (unknown setup).

FUN_00065d64 is NOT a direct callback registrar but an init/wrapper function. Signature: (int flagA, int flagB, int ctx, void *maybe_cb, void *arg5). Parses descriptors via FUN_000c2b58, calls FUN_00064094 to build endpoint dispatch tables (bitmask arrays, not function pointers), enables USB hardware/IRQs when flagB=1. Call from FUN_0002b930 passes all zeros for callback params, only triggers hardware init. Real callback handlers stored elsewhere. FUN_00064094 builds endpoint tables using globals DAT_000644b8/bc, allocates buffers via FUN_0002f530.

next_steps: Find all xrefs to literal pool at 0x00030ab8 (0xB8007000) to map UDC register usage and endpoints
Locate descriptor pointer tables referencing 0x00475140 and VID/PID fields
Identify USB IRQ handler by searching for writes to UDC INT/EP status registers (offsets near 0x7c, etc.)
Map MSC class callbacks and SCSI command dispatch to mirror for CDC
Assess code/data regions that can be freed for CDC stub insertion
raw_note:
Work to date:
- Descriptor blob at VA 0x00475140 decoded to MSC device string "W55FA93 USB Card Reader 1.00" (VID:PID 0416:0093 assumed; VID/PID not yet located as separate scalars).
- Ghidra xref search did not find direct refs to 0x00475140; descriptors likely pulled via offset tables.
- MMIO constant 0xB8007000 appears in literal pools (e.g., 0x30ab8). No hits for 0xB8008200 in APP.bin.
- Init stub at 0x00030a94 writes 0x32 into DAT_00030ab4+4 and sets bit1 in *(0xB8007000+0x7C); probable UDC clock/enable.
- Other MMIO bases in data: GP_BA 0xB8001000+, doorbell 0xB800C000; not directly USB-related.
- Memory layout: APP.bin size 2,576,940 bytes; trailing 0xFF padding = 0 (file fully packed). Free space must be carved from unused code/data.

Detailed FUN_0005c1a0 endpoint/FIFO register sequence (from decompiled code):
```c
iVar1 = DAT_0005c3d8;  // Load UDC base pointer

// Endpoint/FIFO Register Writes:
*(undefined4 *)(&DAT_00001108 + iVar1) = 7;        // base+0x1108 = 7
*(undefined4 *)(&UNK_00001124 + iVar1) = uVar2;    // base+0x1124 = uVar2 (0x30000066)
*(undefined4 *)(&UNK_0000110c + iVar1) = 3;        // base+0x110c = 3  
*(undefined4 *)(&UNK_00001120 + iVar1) = 0xa0;     // base+0x1120 = 0xa0
*(undefined4 *)(&DAT_00001108 + iVar1) = 1;        // base+0x1108 = 1 (overwrite!)
*(undefined4 *)(&UNK_00001120 + iVar1) = 0x7f;     // base+0x1120 = 0x7f (overwrite!)
```

Register interpretation (tentative):
- 0x1108: Endpoint selector/index (7→1 suggests selecting different endpoints)
- 0x110c: Unknown configuration (value: 3)
- 0x1120: FIFO size or offset (0xa0→0x7f)
- 0x1124: Configuration flags (0x30000066 = multiple bit fields)

PHY/Analog registers (outside main UDC block):
- base-0x5000 (0xB8002000) = 0
- base-0x4fe8 (0xB8002018) = 1
- base-0x4fec read and passed to FUN_0000d840

Helper functions in FUN_0005c1a0:
- FUN_000a1928() - early init
- FUN_00031f34(params...) - called 5 times with different parameters
- FUN_0003224c(params...) - called 3 times
- FUN_00032310() - SIE/PHY init (detailed in Evidence #6)
- FUN_00080b7c() - unknown USB setup

Other UDC register accesses:
- base+0x30 = 0, base+0x34 = 0 (clearing)
- base+0x40 bit 3 cleared (control register)
- base+0x7c bit 1 cleared (interrupt control)

summary: Preliminary USB stack map for adding CDC: device descriptor blob at 0x00475140 contains MSC product string "W55FA93 USB Card Reader 1.00" (VID:PID 0416:0093 assumed). Firmware uses MMIO base 0xB8007000 (literal at 0x00030ab8); small init stub at 0x00030a94 sets *(DAT_00030ab4+4)=0x32 and ORs bit1 into *(0xB8007000+0x7C), likely enabling the USB device controller. APP.bin is fully occupied (2,576,940 bytes) with no trailing 0xFF padding, so space must be reclaimed for CDC code.
